# LAMMPS input script for Fe grain boundary tensile test

# Initialization
units           metal
atom_style      atomic
boundary        p p p
read_data       /structures/task_9/Fe_110_sig3.txt

# Define potential
pair_style      eam/fs
pair_coeff      * * /potentials/EAM/Fe-C_Hepburn_Ackland.eam.fs Fe

# Initial minimization
fix             1 all box/relax x 0.0 z 0.0
minimize        1.0e-15 1.0e-15 1000 1000
unfix           1

# Define groups for fixed regions and delete atoms far from boundary
region          top block INF INF 0.85 INF INF INF
region          bottom block INF INF INF 0.15 INF INF
region          middle block INF INF 0.15 0.85 INF INF
group           top region top
group           bottom region bottom
group           middle region middle

# Delete atoms far from boundary to avoid artifacts
group           tobedeleted subtract all middle
delete_atoms    group tobedeleted

# Setup for tensile deformation
variable        strain equal 0.0
variable        strain_rate equal 0.0001
variable        N equal 100    # number of strain increments
variable        dt equal 0.001

# Output settings
variable        stress_xx equal pxx
variable        stress_yy equal pyy
variable        stress_zz equal pzz

fix             2 all print 1 "${strain} ${stress_xx} ${stress_yy} ${stress_zz}" file stress_strain_raw.txt

# Deformation loop
label           loop
variable        i loop ${N}
    # Increment strain
    variable    strain equal ${strain}+${strain_rate}
    
    # Apply displacement to fixed groups
    displace_atoms top move 0.0 ${strain} 0.0
    
    # Minimize energy
    minimize    1.0e-15 1.0e-15 1000 1000
    
next           i
jump           in.tensile loop

# Convert stress values from bars to GPa and write final output
print          "All done"

# LAMMPS input script for Fe grain boundary tensile test

# Initialization
units           metal
dimension       3
boundary        p p p
atom_style      atomic

# Read structure
read_data       /structures/task_9/Fe_110_sig3.txt

# Define potential
pair_style      eam/fs
pair_coeff      * * /potentials/EAM/Fe-C_Hepburn_Ackland.eam.fs Fe

# Energy minimization
thermo          100
thermo_style    custom step pe lx ly lz press pxx pyy pzz
min_style       cg
fix             1 all box/relax x 0.0 z 0.0
minimize        1.0e-15 1.0e-15 1000 1000
unfix           1

# Define regions and groups
region          top block INF INF 0.85 INF INF INF units box
region          bottom block INF INF INF 0.15 INF INF units box
region          middle block INF INF 0.15 0.85 INF INF units box
group           top region top
group           bottom region bottom
group           middle region middle
group           boundary union top bottom
group           mobile subtract all boundary

# Delete unnecessary atoms
group           tobedeleted subtract all middle
delete_atoms    group tobedeleted

# Setup for tensile deformation
variable        strain equal 0.0
variable        strain_rate equal 0.0001
variable        N equal 100

# Compute stress in GPa
variable        s_xx equal pxx*1.0e-4
variable        s_yy equal pyy*1.0e-4
variable        s_zz equal pzz*1.0e-4

# Output stress-strain data
fix             ss_out all print 1 "${strain} ${s_xx} ${s_yy} ${s_zz}" file stress_strain.txt

# Deformation loop
label           loop
variable        i loop ${N}
    # Increment strain
    variable    strain equal ${strain}+${strain_rate}
    
    # Move top group
    displace_atoms top move 0.0 ${strain} 0.0
    
    # Minimize with fixed boundary
    fix          2 boundary setforce 0.0 0.0 0.0
    min_style    cg
    minimize     1.0e-15 1.0e-15 1000 1000
    unfix        2
    
next           i
jump           in.tensile loop

print          "All done"

# LAMMPS input script for Fe grain boundary tensile test

# Initialization
units           metal
atom_style      atomic
boundary        p p p

# Read structure
read_data       /structures/task_9/Fe_110_sig3.txt

# Define potential
pair_style      eam/fs
pair_coeff      * * /potentials/EAM/Fe-C_Hepburn_Ackland.eam.fs Fe

# Initial minimization
fix             1 all box/relax x 0.0 z 0.0
minimize        1.0e-15 1.0e-15 1000 1000
unfix           1

# Define regions and groups for loading
region          top block INF INF 0.9*yhi INF INF INF
region          bottom block INF INF INF 0.1*yhi INF INF
group           top region top
group           bottom region bottom
group           mobile subtract all top bottom

# Delete atoms far from boundary (middle 60% kept)
region          keep block INF INF 0.2*yhi 0.8*yhi INF INF
group           keep region keep
delete_atoms    group !keep

# Output settings
variable        strain equal "(ly - v_initial_length)/v_initial_length"
variable        stress_xx equal "pxx*0.0001"  # Convert from bars to GPa
variable        stress_yy equal "pyy*0.0001"
variable        stress_zz equal "pzz*0.0001"

# Store initial length
variable        initial_length equal "ly"

# Create output file
fix             ss_out all print 100 "${strain},${stress_xx},${stress_yy},${stress_zz}" file stress_strain.txt screen no

# Deformation settings
variable        strain_rate equal 0.0001
variable        timestep equal 0.001
variable        total_steps equal 50000

# Apply tensile deformation
fix             2 top move linear 0.0 ${strain_rate} 0.0
fix             3 bottom move linear 0.0 -${strain_rate} 0.0
fix             4 mobile setforce 0.0 0.0 0.0

# Run deformation with minimization every 100 steps
dump            1 all custom 100 dump.tensile id type x y z
thermo         100
thermo_style   custom step temp pe press pxx pyy pzz

label          loop
variable       i loop 500
  run          100
  minimize     1.0e-15 1.0e-15 1000 1000
next          i
jump          in.tensile loop

# Initialization
units           metal
atom_style      atomic
boundary        p p p

# Read structure
read_data       /structures/task_9/Fe_110_sig3.txt

# Define potential
pair_style      eam/fs
pair_coeff      * * /potentials/EAM/Fe-C_Hepburn_Ackland.eam.fs Fe

# Energy minimization
minimize        1.0e-15 1.0e-15 1000 1000

# Store initial length
variable        initial_length equal ly

# Define regions and groups for loading
region          top block INF INF 0.9*yhi INF INF INF
region          bottom block INF INF INF 0.1*yhi INF INF
group           top region top
group           bottom region bottom
group           mobile subtract all top bottom

# Delete atoms far from boundary
region          near_boundary block INF INF 0.2*yhi 0.8*yhi INF INF
group           keep region near_boundary
group           delete subtract all keep
delete_atoms    group delete

# Output settings
thermo          100
thermo_style    custom step temp pe press pxx pyy pzz
thermo_modify   format float %20.10g

# Stress-strain calculation
variable        strain equal "(ly - v_initial_length)/v_initial_length"
variable        press_xx equal pxx
variable        press_yy equal pyy
variable        press_zz equal pzz
variable        stress_xx equal "v_press_xx/10000"  # Convert from bars to GPa
variable        stress_yy equal "v_press_yy/10000"
variable        stress_zz equal "v_press_zz/10000"

# Create output file
fix             ss_out all print 100 "${strain} ${stress_xx} ${stress_yy} ${stress_zz}" file stress_strain.txt screen no

# Deformation
fix             2 top move linear 0.0 0.0002 0.0
fix             3 bottom move linear 0.0 -0.0002 0.0
fix             4 mobile nve

# Run deformation with minimization steps
label           loop
variable        i loop 500
  run           100
  minimize      1.0e-15 1.0e-15 1000 1000
next           i
jump           in.tensile loop

arguments.content:
# LAMMPS input script for Al single crystal tensile test

# Initialization
units           metal
dimension       3
boundary        p p p
atom_style      atomic

# Create FCC lattice
lattice         fcc 4.05
region          box block 0 10 0 10 0 10
create_box      1 box
create_atoms    1 box

# Define potential
pair_style      eam/alloy
pair_coeff      * * /potentials/EAM/Al_zhou.eam.alloy Al

# Energy minimization
minimize        1.0e-6 1.0e-8 1000 10000

# Set timestep
timestep        0.001

# Define compute for stress
compute         str all pressure thermo_temp

# Equilibration - NPT at 300K and 0 pressure
velocity        all create 300.0 12345
fix             1 all npt temp 300.0 300.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0

# Output settings for equilibration
thermo          100
thermo_style    custom step temp press pe ke etotal c_str[1] c_str[2] c_str[3]
dump            1 all custom 100 equil.dump id type x y z

# Run equilibration for 20ps (20000 timesteps)
run             20000

unfix           1
undump          1

# Reset time step
reset_timestep  0

# Deformation - NPT with uniaxial tension
fix             2 all npt temp 300.0 300.0 0.1 y 0.0 0.0 1.0 z 0.0 0.0 1.0
fix             3 all deform 1 x erate 0.01 units box

# Output settings for deformation
variable        strain equal "(lx - v_L0)/v_L0"
variable        L0 equal ${lx}
fix             def1 all print 100 "${strain} $(c_str[1]*0.0001) $(c_str[2]*0.0001) $(c_str[3]*0.0001)" file stress_strain.txt screen no

# Run deformation for 20ps (20000 timesteps)
run             20000

# LAMMPS input script for thermal conductivity calculation

# Initialization
units           lj
atom_style      atomic
dimension       3
boundary        p p p

# Create simulation box and atoms
lattice         fcc 0.6
region          box block 0 10 0 10 0 20
create_box      1 box
create_atoms    1 box

# Define potential
pair_style      lj/cut 2.5
pair_coeff      1 1 1.0 1.0

# Mass
mass            1 1.0

# Initialize velocities
velocity        all create 1.35 87287 dist gaussian

# Define regions for temperature control
region          hot block INF INF INF INF 0 1
region          cold block INF INF INF INF 10 11
group           hot dynamic all region hot
group           cold dynamic all region cold
group           middle subtract all hot cold

# Energy minimization
minimize        1.0e-4 1.0e-6 1000 10000

# Equilibration - NVT
fix             1 all nvt temp 1.35 1.35 0.5
timestep        0.005
thermo          100
run             1000
unfix           1

# Production - NVE with thermostats
compute         ke_hot hot ke/atom
compute         ke_cold cold ke/atom
compute         temp_hot hot temp
compute         temp_cold cold temp
compute         temp_middle middle temp
compute         chunk all chunk/atom bin/1d z 0.0 20.0 40 units reduced
fix             temp_profile all ave/chunk 100 100 10000 chunk temp file temp_profile.dat

# Apply Langevin thermostats to hot and cold regions
fix             hot_thermostat hot langevin 1.70 1.70 1.0 699483
fix             cold_thermostat cold langevin 1.0 1.0 1.0 584783
fix             2 all nve

# Run to establish steady state
run             10000

# Reset energy accumulators and continue
fix             hot_flux hot ave/time 1 1 1 c_ke_hot file hot_energy.dat
fix             cold_flux cold ave/time 1 1 1 c_ke_cold file cold_energy.dat

# Final production run
run             20000

print          "All done"

# LAMMPS input script for thermal conductivity calculation

# Initialization
units           lj
atom_style      atomic
dimension       3
boundary        p p p

# Create simulation box and atoms
lattice         fcc 0.93405  # This density gives number density of 0.6
region          box block 0 10 0 10 0 20
create_box      1 box
create_atoms    1 box

# Define potential
pair_style      lj/cut 2.5
pair_coeff      1 1 1.0 1.0

# Mass (reduced units)
mass            1 1.0

# Initialize velocities
velocity        all create 1.35 87287 dist gaussian

# Define regions for temperature control
region          hot block INF INF INF INF 0 1
region          cold block INF INF INF INF 10 11
group           hot dynamic all region hot
group           cold dynamic all region cold
group           middle subtract all hot cold

# Energy minimization
minimize        1.0e-4 1.0e-6 1000 10000

# Define temperature compute for different regions
compute         Thot all temp/region hot
compute         Tcold all temp/region cold
compute         Tmid all temp/region middle

# First equilibration - NVT
fix             1 all nvt temp 1.35 1.35 0.5
thermo          100
thermo_style    custom step temp c_Thot c_Tcold c_Tmid pe ke etotal
run             1000
unfix           1

# Reset thermostats and switch to NVE with local temperature control
fix             1 all nve
fix             2 hot langevin 1.70 1.70 1.0 699483
fix             3 cold langevin 1.0 1.0 1.0 584783
fix             4 all ave/time 100 1 100 c_Thot c_Tcold file temp_profile.dat

# Run to establish steady state
run             10000

# Reset Langevin energy accumulation and continue
fix             5 all ave/spatial 100 100 10000 z lower 0.5 v_temp file temp_gradient.dat units reduced

# Final production run
run             20000

# Print thermal conductivity
variable        dT equal c_Thot-c_Tcold
variable        flux equal "(f_2+f_3)/(2*10*10)"  # Heat flux through cross section
variable        k equal "-${flux}/(${dT}/20)"     # Thermal conductivity
print           "Thermal conductivity = ${k}"

# LAMMPS input script for thermal conductivity calculation

# Initialization
units           lj
atom_style      atomic
dimension       3
boundary        p p p

# Create simulation box and atoms
lattice         fcc 0.93405  # This density gives number density of 0.6
region          box block 0 10 0 10 0 20
create_box      1 box
create_atoms    1 box

# Define potential
pair_style      lj/cut 2.5
pair_coeff      1 1 1.0 1.0

# Mass (in LJ units)
mass            1 1.0

# Initialize velocities
velocity        all create 1.35 87287 dist gaussian

# Define regions for temperature control
region          hot block INF INF INF INF 0 1
region          cold block INF INF INF INF 10 11
group           hot dynamic all region hot
group           cold dynamic all region cold
group           middle subtract all hot cold

# Energy minimization
minimize        1.0e-4 1.0e-6 1000 10000

# Equilibration in NVT
fix             1 all nvt temp 1.35 1.35 0.5
thermo          100
run             1000
unfix           1

# Production run with temperature gradient
compute         ke_hot hot ke/atom
compute         ke_cold cold ke/atom
compute         temp_hot hot temp
compute         temp_cold cold temp
compute         temp_middle middle temp
compute         chunk_temp all chunk/atom bin/1d z 0.0 20.0 40 units reduced

# Apply Langevin thermostats to hot and cold regions
fix             hot_thermostat hot langevin 1.70 1.70 1.0 699483
fix             cold_thermostat cold langevin 1.0 1.0 1.0 584783
fix             2 all nve
fix             3 all ave/chunk 100 100 10000 chunk_temp temp file temp_profile.dat

# First phase of production
thermo_style    custom step temp c_temp_hot c_temp_cold c_temp_middle f_hot_thermostat f_cold_thermostat
thermo          100
run             10000

# Reset Langevin energy accumulation and continue
fix             hot_thermostat hot langevin 1.70 1.70 1.0 699483
fix             cold_thermostat cold langevin 1.0 1.0 1.0 584783
run             20000

# Output final averages
variable        deltaT equal c_temp_hot-c_temp_cold
variable        deltaZ equal 10.0
variable        heatflux equal (f_hot_thermostat+(-f_cold_thermostat))/(2*10*10)
variable        k equal ${heatflux}/${deltaT}*${deltaZ}
print          "Thermal conductivity = ${k}"

group           middle subtract all hot cold

# Define temperature computation for different regions
compute         Thot hot temp
compute         Tcold cold temp
compute         Tmid middle temp

# First equilibration - NVT
fix             1 all nvt temp 1.35 1.35 0.5
thermo          100
thermo_style    custom step temp c_Thot c_Tcold c_Tmid ke pe etotal
run             1000
unfix           1

# Switch to NVE with Langevin thermostats
fix             2 middle nve
fix             3 hot langevin 1.70 1.70 1.0 699483
fix             4 cold langevin 1.0 1.0 1.0 834729

# Compute heat flux
compute         ke all ke/atom
compute         pe all pe/atom
compute         stress all stress/atom NULL virial
compute         flux all heat/flux ke pe stress
variable        Jz equal c_flux[3]/vol
fix             JZ all ave/time 1 1 1 v_Jz file heat_flux.dat

# Run to establish steady state
run             10000

# Reset and continue for statistics
reset_timestep  0
fix             temp_profile all ave/spatial 100 200 20000 z lower 0.5 c_Thot file temp_profile.dat units reduced
fix             flux_avg all ave/time 100 200 20000 c_flux[3] file flux_avg.dat

run             20000

print          "Simulation completed successfully"

import numpy as np

# Read energies from files
with open('bulk_energy.txt', 'r') as f:
    E_bulk_per_atom = float(f.read().strip())

with open('surface_energy.txt', 'r') as f:
    E_surf_per_atom = float(f.read().strip())

# Calculate number of atoms (5x5x5 FCC unit cells)
n_atoms = 5 * 5 * 5 * 4  # 4 atoms per FCC unit cell

# Calculate surface area (5x5 unit cells in x-y plane)
a = 4.05  # lattice constant in Angstroms
surface_area = 5 * a * 5 * a  # in Angstroms^2

# Calculate surface energy
E_bulk_total = E_bulk_per_atom * n_atoms
E_surf_total = E_surf_per_atom * n_atoms

# Factor of 2 because we created two surfaces (top and bottom)
surface_energy = (E_surf_total - E_bulk_total) / (2 * surface_area)

# Convert from eV/Angstrom^2 to J/m^2
surface_energy_ev_per_ang2 = surface_energy

# Write result to file
with open('surface_energy_result.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(str(surface_energy_ev_per_ang2))

# LAMMPS input script for elastic constant calculation

# Initialization
units metal
dimension 3
boundary p p p
atom_style atomic

# Create FCC aluminum crystal
lattice fcc 4.05
region box block 0 5 0 5 0 5
create_box 1 box
create_atoms 1 box

# Define potential
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Al99.eam.alloy Al

# Energy minimization settings
minimize 1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000

# Initial relaxation with box/relax
fix 1 all box/relax iso 0.0
minimize 1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000
unfix 1

# Store the relaxed configuration
write_data relaxed.data

# Calculate elastic constants
# Define deformation size
variable up equal 0.003
variable down equal -${up}

# Output settings
thermo_style custom step temp pe press pxx pyy pzz pxy pxz pyz
thermo 100

# Perform deformations
# 1) exx
change_box all x scale 1.003 remap
minimize 1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000
print "strain_xx ${up} stress_xx $(pxx) stress_yy $(pyy) stress_zz $(pzz) stress_yz $(pyz) stress_xz $(pxz) stress_xy $(pxy)" file strain_stress_1.txt
change_box all x scale 0.994 remap
minimize 1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000
print "strain_xx ${down} stress_xx $(pxx) stress_yy $(pyy) stress_zz $(pzz) stress_yz $(pyz) stress_xz $(pxz) stress_xy $(pxy)" append strain_stress_1.txt

# Reset box
read_data relaxed.data

# 2) eyy
change_box all y scale 1.003 remap
minimize 1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000
print "strain_yy ${up} stress_xx $(pxx) stress_yy $(pyy) stress_zz $(pzz) stress_yz $(pyz) stress_xz $(pxz) stress_xy $(pxy)" file strain_stress_2.txt
change_box all y scale 0.994 remap
minimize 1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000
print "strain_yy ${down} stress_xx $(pxx) stress_yy $(pyy) stress_zz $(pzz) stress_yz $(pyz) stress_xz $(pxz) stress_xy $(pxy)" append strain_stress_2.txt

# Reset box
read_data relaxed.data

# 3) ezz
change_box all z scale 1.003 remap
minimize 1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000
print "strain_zz ${up} stress_xx $(pxx) stress_yy $(pyy) stress_zz $(pzz) stress_yz $(pyz) stress_xz $(pxz) stress_xy $(pxy)" file strain_stress_3.txt
change_box all z scale 0.994 remap
minimize 1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000
print "strain_zz ${down} stress_xx $(pxx) stress_yy $(pyy) stress_zz $(pzz) stress_yz $(pyz) stress_xz $(pxz) stress_xy $(pxy)" append strain_stress_3.txt

# Reset box
read_data relaxed.data

# 4) exy
change_box all xy delta 0.003 remap
minimize 1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000
print "strain_xy ${up} stress_xx $(pxx) stress_yy $(pyy) stress_zz $(pzz) stress_yz $(pyz) stress_xz $(pxz) stress_xy $(pxy)" file strain_stress_4.txt
change_box all xy delta -0.006 remap
minimize 1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000
print "strain_xy ${down} stress_xx $(pxx) stress_yy $(pyy) stress_zz $(pzz) stress_yz $(pyz) stress_xz $(pxz) stress_xy $(pxy)" append strain_stress_4.txt

# Reset box
read_data relaxed.data

# 5) exz
change_box all xz delta 0.003 remap
minimize 1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000
print "strain_xz ${up} stress_xx $(pxx) stress_yy $(pyy) stress_zz $(pzz) stress_yz $(pyz) stress_xz $(pxz) stress_xy $(pxy)" file strain_stress_5.txt
change_box all xz delta -0.006 remap
minimize 1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000
print "strain_xz ${down} stress_xx $(pxx) stress_yy $(pyy) stress_zz $(pzz) stress_yz $(pyz) stress_xz $(pxz) stress_xy $(pxy)" append strain_stress_5.txt

# Reset box
read_data relaxed.data

# 6) eyz
change_box all yz delta 0.003 remap
minimize 1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000
print "strain_yz ${up} stress_xx $(pxx) stress_yy $(pyy) stress_zz $(pzz) stress_yz $(pyz) stress_xz $(pxz) stress_xy $(pxy)" file strain_stress_6.txt
change_box all yz delta -0.006 remap
minimize 1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000
print "strain_yz ${down} stress_xx $(pxx) stress_yy $(pyy) stress_zz $(pzz) stress_yz $(pyz) stress_xz $(pxz) stress_xy $(pxy)" append strain_stress_6.txt

import numpy as np

def calculate_elastic_constants():
    # Initialize elastic constant matrix
    C = np.zeros((6, 6))
    
    # Process each strain direction
    for i in range(1, 7):
        with open(f'strain_stress_{i}.txt', 'r') as f:
            lines = f.readlines()
            
        # Parse the stress values
        strain_up = float(lines[0].split()[1])
        stress_up = [float(x) for x in lines[0].split()[3::2]]
        
        strain_down = float(lines[1].split()[1])
        stress_down = [float(x) for x in lines[1].split()[3::2]]
        
        # Calculate elastic constants using central difference
        delta_strain = strain_up - strain_down
        delta_stress = [(up - down) for up, down in zip(stress_up, stress_down)]
        
        # Fill the elastic constant matrix
        C[i-1] = [s/delta_strain for s in delta_stress]
    
    return C

def calculate_bulk_modulus(C):
    # Voigt average for bulk modulus
    # B = (C11 + C22 + C33 + 2(C12 + C23 + C31))/9
    B = (C[0,0] + C[1,1] + C[2,2] + 2*(C[0,1] + C[1,2] + C[2,0]))/9
    return B

# Calculate elastic constants
C = calculate_elastic_constants()

# Calculate bulk modulus (in GPa, as we used metal units)
B = calculate_bulk_modulus(C)

# Write result to file
with open('bulk_modulus.txt', 'w') as f:
    f.write(str(B))

create_atoms    1 box

pair_coeff      * * /potentials/EAM/Al99.eam.alloy Al

# Energy minimization settings
minimize        1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000

# Initial relaxation
fix             1 all box/relax iso 0.0
minimize        1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000
unfix           1

variable        down equal -${up}

variable        c11 equal "(v_up-v_down)/(2.0*v_up)"
variable        c12 equal "(v_up+v_down)/(2.0*v_up)"
variable        c44 equal "(v_up-v_down)/(4.0*v_up)"

# +x tensile deformation
change_box      all x delta 0 ${up} xy delta 0 0 xz delta 0 0 remap units box
minimize        1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000
variable        s1 equal -pxx
variable        s2 equal -pyy
variable        s3 equal -pzz

change_box      all x delta 0 ${down} xy delta 0 0 xz delta 0 0 remap units box

variable        s6 equal -pzz

# LAMMPS input script for calculating bulk modulus of Al

# Initialization
units           metal
dimension       3
boundary        p p p
atom_style      atomic

# Create FCC Al structure
lattice         fcc 4.05
region          box block 0 5 0 5 0 5
create_box      1 box
create_atoms    1 box

# Define potential
pair_style      eam/alloy
pair_coeff      * * /potentials/EAM/Al99.eam.alloy Al

# Energy minimization
minimize        1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000

# Store initial volume
variable        V0 equal vol

# Apply positive volumetric strain
variable        strain equal 0.001
change_box      all x scale 1.001 y scale 1.001 z scale 1.001 remap
minimize        1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000
variable        P1 equal -(pxx + pyy + pzz)/3.0

# Return to original
change_box      all x scale 0.999 y scale 0.999 z scale 0.999 remap
minimize        1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000

# Apply negative volumetric strain
change_box      all x scale 0.999 y scale 0.999 z scale 0.999 remap
minimize        1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000
variable        P2 equal -(pxx + pyy + pzz)/3.0

# Calculate bulk modulus (K = -V(dP/dV))
variable        dP equal v_P1-v_P2
variable        dV equal 2.0*v_strain*v_V0
variable        bulk_modulus equal -v_V0*v_dP/v_dV

# Print result
print          "Bulk Modulus (GPa) = ${bulk_modulus}"

# LAMMPS input script for calculating elastic constants of Al

# Initialization
units           metal
atom_style      atomic
boundary        p p p

# Create FCC aluminum crystal
lattice         fcc 4.05
region          box block 0 5 0 5 0 5
create_box      1 box
create_atoms    1 box

# Define potential
pair_style      eam/alloy
pair_coeff      * * /potentials/EAM/Al99.eam.alloy Al

# Energy minimization settings
minimize        1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000

# Initial relaxation
fix             1 all box/relax iso 0.0
minimize        1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000
unfix           1

# Store the relaxed state
write_dump      all custom relaxed.dump id type x y z

# Calculate elastic constants
# Define deformation size
variable        up equal 0.003
variable        down equal -${up}

# Define 6 deformation styles
variable        d1 equal ${up}
variable        d2 equal ${down}

# Loop over 6 independent deformations
label           loop

# Positive deformation
change_box      all triclinic
change_box      all xy delta ${d1} remap units box
minimize        1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000

# Get stress components
variable        pxx equal pxx
variable        pyy equal pyy
variable        pzz equal pzz
variable        pxy equal pxy
variable        pxz equal pxz
variable        pyz equal pyz

print          "Stress tensor components: ${pxx} ${pyy} ${pzz} ${pxy} ${pxz} ${pyz}"

# Reset box to original shape
change_box      all xy delta ${d2} remap units box

# Next deformation
next            d1
next            d2
jump            in.elastic loop

# Calculate bulk modulus (Voigt average)
variable        bulkmodulus equal (c11+c22+c33+2*(c12+c13+c23))/9
print          "Bulk modulus = ${bulkmodulus} GPa"

units           metal

# Create FCC aluminum crystal
lattice         fcc 4.05
region          box block 0 5 0 5 0 5
create_box      1 box
create_atoms    1 box

# Define potential
pair_style      eam/alloy
pair_coeff      * * /potentials/EAM/Al99.eam.alloy Al

# Energy minimization settings
minimize        1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000

# Initial relaxation
fix             1 all box/relax iso 0.0
minimize        1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000
unfix           1

# Store the relaxed state
write_dump      all custom relaxed.dump id type x y z

# Calculate elastic constants
# Define deformation size
variable        up equal 0.003
variable        down equal -${up}

# Define variables for stress components
variable        pxx equal pxx
variable        pyy equal pyy
variable        pzz equal pzz
variable        pxy equal pxy
variable        pxz equal pxz
variable        pyz equal pyz

# Output initial stresses
print          "Initial stress state:"
print          "$(v_pxx) ${pxy} ${pxz}"
print          "${pxy} $(v_pyy) ${pyz}"
print          "${pxz} ${pyz} $(v_pzz)"

# Deform box and calculate elastic constants
variable        c11 equal (-v_pxx/(2.0*${up}))
variable        c22 equal (-v_pyy/(2.0*${up}))
variable        c33 equal (-v_pzz/(2.0*${up}))
variable        c44 equal (-v_pyz/(2.0*${up}))
variable        c55 equal (-v_pxz/(2.0*${up}))
variable        c66 equal (-v_pxy/(2.0*${up}))

# Apply deformations and measure stress response
# XX deformation
change_box      all x delta 0 ${up} remap units box
minimize        1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000
print          "C11 = ${c11}"
change_box      all x delta 0 ${down} remap units box
minimize        1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000

# YY deformation
change_box      all y delta 0 ${up} remap units box
minimize        1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000
print          "C22 = ${c22}"
change_box      all y delta 0 ${down} remap units box
minimize        1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000

# ZZ deformation
change_box      all z delta 0 ${up} remap units box
minimize        1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000
print          "C33 = ${c33}"
change_box      all z delta 0 ${down} remap units box
minimize        1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000

# YZ deformation
change_box      all yz delta ${up} remap units box
minimize        1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000
print          "C44 = ${c44}"
change_box      all yz delta ${down} remap units box
minimize        1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000

# XZ deformation
change_box      all xz delta ${up} remap units box
minimize        1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000
print          "C55 = ${c55}"
change_box      all xz delta ${down} remap units box
minimize        1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000

# XY deformation
change_box      all xy delta ${up} remap units box
minimize        1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000
print          "C66 = ${c66}"
change_box      all xy delta ${down} remap units box
minimize        1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000

# Calculate bulk modulus using Voigt average
# K = (C11 + C22 + C33 + 2(C12 + C13 + C23))/9
variable        bulk_modulus equal (${c11}+${c22}+${c33}+2*(${c12}+${c13}+${c23}))/9
print          "Bulk modulus = ${bulk_modulus} GPa"

# LAMMPS input script for calculating elastic constants of Al
units           metal
atom_style      atomic
boundary        p p p

# Create FCC aluminum crystal
lattice         fcc 4.05
region          box block 0 5 0 5 0 5
create_box      1 box
create_atoms    1 box

# Define potential
pair_style      eam/alloy
pair_coeff      * * /potentials/EAM/Al99.eam.alloy Al

# Output settings
thermo          100
thermo_style    custom step pe press pxx pyy pzz pxy pxz pyz

# Initial minimization
minimize        1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000

# Store initial pressure
variable        p0 equal press
print          "Initial pressure = $(v_p0) GPa"

# Apply uniform strain
change_box      all x scale 1.003 y scale 1.003 z scale 1.003 remap
minimize        1.0e-10 0.0 100 1000

# Get final pressure
variable        p1 equal press
print          "Final pressure = $(v_p1) GPa"

# Calculate bulk modulus (K = -V*dP/dV)
# For 0.3% strain in each direction, total volumetric strain = 0.009
variable        bulk_modulus equal -(v_p1-v_p0)/0.009
print          "Bulk modulus = ${bulk_modulus} GPa"
